as_told.title: Woman's death witnessed at LAX, time slows and sound returns

plain: A writer named Brent Friedman tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about something he says happened in the 1980s at Los Angeles International Airport, known as LAX. He says he was there when a woman on foot was fatally hit. The airport is a very noisy place, he says, but in that moment he heard nothing except her breathing. He adds that time seemed to slow, and that at the moment she died, all the noise of the airport came rushing back. Brent is the only teller, describing it twice in the same interview. He tells it as a moment when ordinary reality seemed to fall away around a death.
